description.en: Sets whether a registered object is visible during one cut of the next HQ event. The object must have been registered with CMND_REG_HDL_HQ_EVENT, and not as the camera. An HQ event (see RunHQEvent) plays its cuts with the objects registered here.
Always null (nothing changes if the object is not registered or is the camera).

examples.case: Objects that only appear in some cuts (real usage, from ev42123400.nut)
